name: Hop Step Sing! Everywhere!
summary:
The 8th VRMV 『Everywhere!』 by VR idol group Hop Step Sing!

Idol sings in your room!?

This time, using XR and MR technology, Mikasa will come to your room and sing and dance right in front of you. Also, she will try her hand at a cool English song!You can fight away the monster with Mikasa too!  Enjoy the dreamy experience of having an idol in your room all to yourself through XR and MR !
